item.title: Kasm - Functional Changes
item.description: We have published a functional update to our Kasm image that changes the behaviour of the install wizard to close a potential security gap. Going forward, the install wizard will be disabled after initial install unless you explicitly opt-in via environment variable, which will be required for performing upgrades of the Kasm software. These changes are reflected in the image readme. As part of general security good practices, you should never publicly expose the install wizard port.
